name: St Mary the Virgin Church

layers.essential_history: [[c:St Mary's is Grade I listed. Its Norman font dates from around 1120 and was brought here from Sibberton Lodge in the parish of Thornhaugh.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Churches along the Great North Road saw centuries of travellers passing by.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:The sexton says Nell Briggs was polishing the church brass all evening for Sunday, with the vicar's wife beside her.]]

evidence: [[c:Nell Briggs was polishing the church brass all evening, with a witness.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head north-east, about 100 metres as the crow flies, to the old Great North Road.  Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
